collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-04  -  THE QUIET DEFENDER SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A child hears several friends dismiss a shy classmate's ideas during a group activity.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child hears several friends dismiss a shy classmate's ideas during a group activity.

choices.label: Ask Everyone to Hear the Classmate's Suggestion.
Ask the Teacher for Guidance Without Naming Anyone Publicly.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The suggestion solves a problem the group had overlooked.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The classmate chooses not to speak, but appreciates being offered the opportunity.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The child learns that the classmate would rather contribute through drawing.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The classmate admits feeling excluded and agrees to try again tomorrow.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The children discover that several quiet classmates have useful ideas.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The new arrangement feels awkward initially, but the group continues practicing.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The teacher introduces a cooperative activity that gives everyone a role.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The teacher observes the group and later addresses the exclusion privately.
